douay.rights_basis: The 1582 and 1610 margins. Out of copyright everywhere, and the transcription is dedicated to the public domain.

na27.name: New Testament allusions to the deuterocanonical books
na27.rights_basis: 292 pairs of addresses and no text of any kind. A bare pair of Scripture references is a fact about Scripture rather than an expression of anyone's editorial work. LIMITS.md carries the reasoning and the fact that it is a reading rather than a ruling.
